subtitle: Tea notes, fully offline
promotional_text: File a leaf, cup it on this phone, then rewrite the note. Keep what you’d steep again. No account, no Wi-Fi.
description: Kettleleaf is a private tea journal that lives on your phone. Build caddies around one family, file leaves with a steeping seed and a form, then cup a note on-device. Steep stages, a pouch of kept cups and a move log — all stored on your phone, with no account and no network calls.
app_review_notes: Offline tea journal with an on-device cupping note writer. Create caddies, file leaves (name + steep seed + form), open Cupping to compose a note locally, rewrite, and grade. No sign-in, no network calls. Camera and photo library are optional and only used when attaching a picture of dry leaf or a cup. Please load morning greens on first launch, open Cupping, compose, rewrite, and grade.
